Help.intro: The words you see on screen, what they mean and the technical term behind each one.

empty.title: No matching entry
empty.description: Try another word, or clear the search to see every entry.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.explanation: Your own area in EDI Bridge. It holds your trading partners, mappings and every document exchanged with them.

showcaseWorkspace.label: Demo
showcaseWorkspace.explanation: A ready-made example area to look around in. Nothing in it can be changed.

tradingPartner.label: Trading partner
tradingPartner.explanation: A company you exchange business documents with, for example a retailer that orders goods from you.

testMode.label: Testing
testMode.explanation: While you set up a new trading partner, every transmission with them is marked as a test.

interchange.label: Transmission
interchange.explanation: One EDI file sent to or received from a trading partner. It can hold several documents.

acknowledgement.label: Receipt confirmation
acknowledgement.explanation: The receiver’s automatic reply. It confirms that a transmission arrived and could be read, or says whether its content was accepted.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.explanation: A sent transmission whose receipt confirmation has not arrived within the time agreed with the trading partner.

businessReference.label: Order number
businessReference.explanation: The number that ties a purchase order, its dispatch advice and its invoice together.

orderLifecycle.label: Order
orderLifecycle.explanation: All documents with the same order number, in the order they happened: purchase order, dispatch advice, invoice and their receipt confirmations.

channel.label: Connection
channel.explanation: The way documents arrive or leave, for example an SFTP folder or a web address.

documentStructure.label: Data format
documentStructure.explanation: A file format from your own systems: its fields, nesting and repeated parts, learned from an example file or a schema.

mapping.label: Mapping
mapping.explanation: Describes which field of your data fills which field of the EDI document, and back.

lookupTable.label: Code translation
lookupTable.explanation: A list that translates codes, for example your unit ST becomes your partner’s PCE.

mappingVersion.label: Version
mappingVersion.explanation: A published state of a mapping that never changes. Each document route uses one version, and every document shows the version that processed it.

draft.label: Draft
draft.explanation: The working copy of a mapping that you edit. Publishing it creates a new version.

sampleDocument.label: Example document
sampleDocument.explanation: A typical file stored with a mapping. The preview shows what the draft makes of it.

manualSubmission.label: Upload
manualSubmission.explanation: A file you hand in yourself instead of it arriving on a connection. It is processed like any other document and marked as uploaded.

flow.label: Document route
flow.explanation: A rule such as “purchase orders from this partner go through this mapping to your ERP”.

run.label: Document
run.explanation: One document that went through EDI Bridge, with every step, its outcome, any errors and the result.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.explanation: A transmission that arrived a second time. It is recorded but not processed again.

retry.label: Try again
retry.explanation: Repeats only the failed delivery, unchanged. Use it when the receiving system was briefly unreachable.

reprocess.label: Process again
reprocess.explanation: Processes the original document once more with a mapping version you choose, for example after fixing the mapping.

messageTypes.ORDERS: Your trading partner orders goods from you.
messageTypes.DESADV: You tell your trading partner what you ship and when it arrives.
messageTypes.INVOIC: You bill your trading partner for the goods you delivered.
messageTypes.CONTRL: The automatic reply to a transmission: it confirms that the transmission arrived and was either accepted or rejected because of syntax errors.
